# Step - in

`in` · `in_` · category: [Walking the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#walking-the-graph)

Moves to the adjacent vertices over incoming edges, optionally only edges with the given labels.

## Forms

```text
in()
in(arg1: any)
in(arg1: array)
in(arg1: any, arg2: any)
in(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(3).in("created").values("name").to_list()   // ["peter", "josh", "marko"]
```
